author: Akien
prose: valid verbs. you're already tracking and using verbs with some care, so it's not a new idea. the 'cairn' command is a router for them in a way. but i think we need a list of common verbs new things can't step on. like 'get' should return whatever is asked for, prolly in json format. and 'show' should prolly return the same thing, but formatted for humans, like in chat. an example cairnhelp is kind of shorthand for 'cairn help' but it's also kind of shorthand for 'cairn cairn show help' so the longer versions become the 'standard across the system' and we also come up with 'standard shortcuts' --- we're basically tracking the intentions of the command line ui. new requests will be validated against this data. each device will have handlers. the root shim class (since the shims own their commands) should implement common ones: '<device> get pid' should be all you have to do to ask a device it's specific pid. or uptime. or list of verbs it knows. or any other common data, constraints, or capabilities. and that we have ways to show that, and inspect it, and query it and so on.
